summary: Typosquat of microsoft/agent-framework exfiltrating credentials and Azure tokens to webhook.site at every Python start
details: The wheel ships agent_framework_meta.pth containing `import agent_framework_meta`, which runs on every Python interpreter start (not just on `import agent_framework`). The imported module spawns a background thread that harvests installer-side secrets and POSTs a base64+zlib-compressed payload to https://webhook.site/d381fd80-ec62-42ad-8f5c-d1b15103c9bb, whose URL is concealed as a base64 literal (_ENC) decoded at runtime. Collection includes: environment variables matching TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/KEY/AZURE/AWS/GITHUB/OPENAI patterns; credential files ~/.azure, ~/.npmrc, ~/.netrc, ~/.git-credentials, ~/.docker/config.json, Hugging Face tokens; /proc/[0-9]*/environ scraping of other processes; Azure IMDS (169.254.169.254) and App Service IDENTITY_ENDPOINT managed-identity token requests across multiple resource audiences (management.azure.com, vault.azure.net, graph.microsoft.com, storage, etc.); and an ADO OIDC token-exchange POST using SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN against SYSTEM_OIDCREQUESTURI. Package metadata impersonates Microsoft and mimics the real microsoft/agent-framework README as cover. The name resembles the legitimate Microsoft package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
